text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: We should add a 3px solid #005fcc focus ring with no white stroke to improve keyboard navigation. This meets Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) and provides a clear visual indicator for users who rely on keyboard navigation. By choosing a solid focus ring, we're trading off some aesthetic flexibility, but this simple and consistent design ensures that all users can easily see where they are on the page. This decision prioritizes clarity and usability over visual customization, which is essential for making EXCAVA usable by everyone.

name: Reader
text: A 3px solid ring risks looking heavy on small touch targets—like buttons under 24px—where it may clip content or feel oppressive. A 2px ring with 70% white stroke on a 1px dark base meets WCAG 2.2 AA in high-contrast modes and stays light on mobile. Settle it with a live A/B test on a 20px button: measure task completion time and user-reported clarity.

name: Ramp
text:
Use a 2px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 1px white stroke at 70% opacity on all interactive elements. This keeps the ring visible on both light and dark backgrounds while staying light enough for small touch targets like 20px buttons. The trade-off is a slightly softer appearance, but it meets WCAG 2.2 AA in high-contrast modes and avoids clipping content.

name: Reader
text: A 2px ring with a 1px white stroke at 70% opacity still risks blending into light backgrounds on mobile, where contrast drops. A better alternative: use a 2px ring with a 1px dark stroke (e.g., #003d7a) instead—this keeps the ring visible in all modes without relying on opacity tricks. Settle it with a live A/B test on both light and dark themes, measuring task completion time for keyboard users.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Adopt the 2px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 2px #fff outer stroke at 70% opacity for all interactive elements. Result: A live A/B test on a 20px button confirming WCAG 2.2 AA compliance and mobile visibility. Owner: accessibility-w1.
